meta.source: HaptiConnect 2.7.0 Forza Horizon 5 plugin (native), fitted on a real FH5 drive replayed through it
meta.note: Forza Horizon 5/6 profile (one profile plays FH5 and FH6): the exact-parity build of 2026-09-20 plus the 2026-09-22 parity keys (parity2_final_2026_09_22). Targets HaptiConnect's FH5 plugin at the strengths every reference was recorded at (all 0.5, RPMs 0.51), left channel. Engine: pure rpm/60 tone at every rpm, flat 0.176 (curve 560-12080 rpm, gain 0.1827). Shift light: 70.0 Hz step to 0.40 at 0.8375-0.8475 x max rpm, no throttle gate, -60 dB in reverse (min_gear 0), kept in neutral. Gear shift: square pitched at rpm/120, 80 ms, gain 0.417 (plateau 0.318). Acceleration: 59 Hz, long and lat curves added while accelerating (combine sum, max() while braking), forward side scaled 0.901, gain 0.28. Wheel slip keeps playing past the old slide/spin band (max 100). Wheel lock: binary at slip ratio 1.0, 54.5 Hz. Impact: one 50 Hz square cycle (20 ms), gain 0.9649. Road bed: 41.2 Hz line following the fastest wheel's SuspensionTravelMeters velocity on the game's packet clock with no hold and no low-speed floor, and a 37-45 Hz band-noise voice following the same velocity; no SurfaceRumble term (see horizon_bed_surface_open).
meta.templates: gear shift, collision and bump one-shots and the kerb cycle are generated in code (effects/base.py synth_template / synth_cycle) from parameters measured on HaptiConnect's output; no recorded audio is used
meta.template_refit: gear_shift no longer uses the template's own freq/duration: it is pitched at rpm/120 for 80 ms (pitch_hz_per_rpm / pitched_duration_s), measured on fh5_drive_4_hc, fh5_drive_5_hc, fh5_drive_1_hc_raw and fh6_drive_2_hc. impact and road keep their earlier energy-matched gains; road plays nothing in Horizon (the game never sets the rumble-strip flag).
meta.local_data: the sessions/ recordings and profiles/cal_* runs named in this profile are the author's local calibration data and are not published
meta.horizon_parity_2026_09_20: the maintainer's calibration notes (not published), scorer cache v5 (openshaker/optimize.cached_render re-renders an effect that reaches the 0.9 knee at a lower gain and scales back, so per-effect renders are linear in gain; every number here was re-measured on it, base and candidate). Built from the shipped profiles/forza_horizon/profile.json with the same notes --spec. Carries the the same notes keys an independent skeptic CONFIRMED and drops the one it refuted (suspension.vel_curve). Per-effect intensity is SYMMETRIC: HaptiConnect's recording vs OUR FULL MIX, same band, same 0.341 s windows, real renders on both sides (the same notes). Median dB (ours - HC), shipped -> this profile, all four laps pooled: engine line +1.2 -> -0.0 (n 379); gear-shift plateau +7.1 -> -0.0 (n 86); shift light at throttle > 0.5 -1.8 -> +0.1 (n 110); shift light at lift-off -14.2 -> -0.1 (n 1); acceleration, straight +6.6 -> +0.7 (n 277), all clean windows +1.2 -> -0.5 (n 1094), lateral >= 6 m/s2 -2.5 -> -1.0 (n 509), combined long >= 3 and lat >= 9 -4.9 -> -2.7 (n 171); slip at low g +2.5 -> +0.9 (n 96); wheel lock while braking -3.7 -> -2.7 (n 39); impact excess energy -3.3 -> -1.8 (n 37); road bed on a narrow 39-43.5 Hz measure +6.5 -> +2.5 median and +4.6 -> -1.8 energy (n 1069). Scores vs the shipped profile, identical on seeds 1 and 2 for this candidate: training Dist 3.721 (seed 2 3.689) -> 3.042, held-out mean Dist 3.838 (3.794) -> 3.679, per lap fh5_drive_4_hc 4.759 -> 4.238, fh5_drive_5_hc 2.683 -> 1.845, fh5_drive_1_hc_raw 3.581 -> 3.823, fh6_drive_2_hc 4.095 -> 3.535. LEVEL: we end 1.0-1.7 dB under HaptiConnect on three of the four laps (mean per-lap |level| 0.685 -> 1.087; held-out 0.785 -> 1.369). No gain was raised to close that gap: it sits in moments only code can fix (see horizon_code_items_2026_09_20).
meta.horizon_bed_2026_09_20: Superseded on 2026-09-22 by horizon_bed_parity2_2026_09_22: the bed no longer uses the shipped law (vel_curve on normalized travel, vel_hold_s 1.0, speed_floor_curve).
meta.horizon_code_items_2026_09_20: Gaps no profile key could express on 2026-09-20 (sizes then in the maintainer's calibration notes (not published)) and where each stands in this file. (1) broadband bed and (3) SuspensionTravelMeters: expressed by keys since 2026-09-22 (horizon_bed_parity2_2026_09_22); what the keys still cannot hold is in horizon_bed_parity2_open. (2) SurfaceRumble: a key exists since 2026-09-22 (suspension surface_add_curve), but this file has no SurfaceRumble term (horizon_bed_surface_open). (4) HaptiConnect adds longitudinal and lateral g: expressed by acceleration.combine sum since 2026-09-22 (parity2_accel); pure lateral g stays too loud, median / energy dB +5.86/+5.90 -> +6.07/+6.07 (n 18) training and +2.53/+3.13 -> +2.82/+3.51 (n 20) held out, shipped -> this file (1.37 s notched measure). (5) [corrected 2026-09-22] HaptiConnect's Horizon hit is the same ~20 ms full-scale square cycle as its Forza Motorsport hit (the earlier ~100-150 ms at ~33 Hz reading came from an 18-35 Hz detector below the hit's spectrum); the template matches it since 2026-09-22 (parity2_impact). What remains is the detector: HaptiConnect plays no hit of its own (its burst peaking >= 0.97 with >= 10 dB excess) at 21 of this file's 40 fires. (6) resolved 2026-09-22 by shift_indicator.min_gear 0 (shift_light_parity2_2026_09_22). (7) FH6 slip is louder in HaptiConnect than FH5 slip, which one profile cannot hold: slip at low g (49-66 Hz, median / energy dB, ours - HaptiConnect) in this file reads fh5_drive_5_hc +2.97/+2.23 (n 40), fh6_drive_2_hc -0.10/-1.64 (n 47).
meta.analysis_superseded: the analysis block below records the 2026-09-10 probes; these entries are superseded by horizon_parity_2026_09_20: engine (no 57 Hz cap above 6800 rpm - the tone is rpm/60 at every rpm), shift_indicator (a step to 0.40 at 0.842 x max rpm, not a ramp, and no throttle gate), gear_shift/gear_shift_lap (a square pitched at rpm/120 for 80 ms, not a 94 ms jittered burst), rumble_strips (Forza Horizon never sets WheelOnRumbleStrip; SurfaceRumble is a material code and HaptiConnect answers it with its 41 Hz bed); suspension (the bed follows SuspensionTravelMeters velocity with a band-noise voice and a SurfaceRumble term: horizon_bed_parity2_2026_09_22).
meta.parity_judgement: Applied 2026-09-20 on the maintainer's exact-parity decision although the maintainer's calibration notes (not published) --set horizon prints NOT accepted on both seeds. Every effect now lands on HaptiConnect when measured at the moments it plays (engine +1.2 -> 0.0 dB, gear shift +7.1 -> 0.0, shift light -1.8 -> +0.1, straight-line acceleration +6.6 -> +0.7, wheel slip +2.5 -> +0.9, wheel lock -3.7 -> -2.7), but the lap as a whole stays 1.0-1.6 dB under HaptiConnect on 3 of 4 laps and two band-share gates move the wrong way. Both are the same cause: the gates were met before only because the profile's errors cancelled (a 7 dB-hot gear shift and a 1.2 dB-hot engine filled bands that HaptiConnect fills with a broadband road bed, combined-axis acceleration and surface rumble we cannot yet render). Those gaps are code items, measured and listed in the same notes; no gain was raised to hide them.

meta.horizon_bed_parity2_2026_09_22: Road bed on the parity keys (fitted in the maintainer's calibration notes (not published), spec the same notes; numbers below re-measured on THIS file in the same notes). LAW: the 41.2 Hz line follows vel_curve_m, v = the fastest wheel's SuspensionTravelMeters velocity between consecutive packets on the game's packet clock (vel_time_source packet, wheel_combine max, bed_env frame = no hold); pre-gain 0.011*(v/0.3)^1.76, 15 knots up to 1.7 m/s. bed_noise: a 37-45 Hz order-4 band-noise voice driven by the same velocity (drive vpeak), pre-gain 0.041 + 0.098*min(v/0.3, 1.55)^1.63; at ordinary road velocities it carries most of the bed, because HaptiConnect's quiet bed is broadband. speed_floor_curve is zero (HaptiConnect has no low-speed floor). gain 0.6 unchanged. vel_curve and vel_hold_s stay in the file unused (racing.py plays vel_curve_m when it is set; bed_env frame has no hold). FIT (bed lane): velocity law and noise on fh5_drive_4_hc + fh5_drive_5_hc only; fh5_drive_1_hc_raw is held out from everything and fh6_drive_2_hc's SurfaceRumble-0 windows from the velocity law. WHY METRES (bed lane): on packet-clock metre velocity HaptiConnect's bed agrees across the four laps' cars (lap-to-lap residual spread 5.1 -> 2.6 dB on the line, 4.3 -> 1.5 dB on the band, against normalized travel). meta.horizon_bed_parity2_open: What the bed keys cannot hold (measured on this file in the maintainer's calibration notes (not published)). (a) FH6 is louder than FH5 at the same metre velocity and one profile plays both games: on held-out fh6_drive_2_hc SurfaceRumble-0 windows the line reads -3.72 dB (energy, n 90) at 0.12-0.2 m/s and -5.91 dB (n 8) above 0.2 m/s, but +6.58 (n 15) below 0.02 m/s and +6.87 (n 29) at 0.02-0.04 m/s. (b) HaptiConnect's energy between 26 and 56 Hz also follows |long g| and |lat g| about as strongly as suspension velocity (bed lane, the same notes), so part of what looks like a broadband bed is probably HaptiConnect's broadband acceleration voice, which ours plays as a 59 Hz tone. (c) The lap-level deficit is not the bed: in this file's full mix the 35-50 Hz band differs from HaptiConnect by -1.9 / -1.4 / -1.4 / -2.2 % of HaptiConnect's lap energy and 50-70 Hz by -14.9 / +8.9 / -5.2 / -17.4 % (fh5_drive_4_hc / fh5_drive_5_hc / fh5_drive_1_hc_raw / fh6_drive_2_hc). (d) The bed's 37-45 Hz noise voice has a skirt in 49-66 Hz: at null g our 49-66 Hz excess is 0.0047 in sine amplitude against HaptiConnect's 0.0009 (held out, 0.341 s windows, n 22), and it moves the straight-line acceleration measure (0.341 s, training) from +0.11/+0.12 without the bed keys to +0.63/+0.40 dB with them. (e) The impact excess-energy row over the 0.45 s before our fires moves -2.24/-1.67 -> -2.17/-2.50 (n 4) on the held-out events because of the bed (see parity2_final_2026_09_22 item a), while the bracketed burst measure at the same hits moves toward HaptiConnect.

meta.parity2_impact: Impact template (fitted in the maintainer's calibration notes (not published), spec the same notes; numbers below re-measured on THIS file in the same notes). SHAPE ONLY: impact.template is the Forza Motorsport profile's 50 Hz square, one cycle (0.020 s, attack 0.002, release 0.004), instead of a 48 Hz saw 0.024 s long. impact.gain stays 0.9649 and the detector (excursion above a 1 s baseline > 15 m/s2 for 0.03 s on long+lat, cooldown 0.3, fixed_amp) is unchanged. WHY THE SAME HIT (impact lane): HaptiConnect's own Horizon and Forza Motorsport hits have the same averaged spectrum within 0.72 dB (centroid 52.2 vs 51.8 Hz), the same -6 dB burst width (20 vs 18 ms) and the same 0.985 peak; the old saw sat 2.42 dB from Horizon's hit, the square 1.15 dB. IN THIS FILE: the detector fires 40 times on the four references (23 / 13 / 0 / 4), exactly as the shipped profile. Intensity, symmetric (HaptiConnect vs this file's full mix, 15-150 Hz burst excess over each side's own local background, +-90 ms, each side's own peak within +-0.2 s): at HaptiConnect's hits (19 of the 40 moments, its own burst >= 0.97 with >= 10 dB excess) training -3.15 -> -2.51 dB (n 16), held out -1.07 -> +0.09 dB (n 3); at the 21 moments where HaptiConnect plays no hit -1.23 -> -0.22 dB. Without the impact template this file reads -3.01 / -0.47 dB at the hits (training / held out). DETECTOR, not changed: HaptiConnect plays no hit of its own at 21 of the 40 fires; a long+lat jump rule cut the training false fires in the impact lane but moved the held-out hits away, so it is not in this file.

meta.horizon_bed_surface_open: 2026-09-22: NO SurfaceRumble term in this file. A surface_add_curve was fitted, but the codes it acts on (0.24, 0.6) occur only on fh6_drive_2_hc, the held-out lap it was then fitted on, so its validation was in-sample and it was removed on the skeptic's verdict (the maintainer's calibration notes (not published)). Without it the 0.6 windows read line -10.0 dB and band -6.8/-7.0 dB (fh6_drive_2_hc, n 8; shipped -13.8/-14.5). One FH5 or FH6 recording on rough ground is needed.

probes.acceleration: ~60 Hz tone; on at ~3 m/s2 accelerating, ~7 braking, ~7 lateral; full scale within ~1-2 m/s2 (lower thresholds than the BeamNG plugin)
probes.collision: fixed ~45 ms hit 20-38 Hz on g jumps >= ~15 m/s2 held >= 3 frames, long or lat; speed drops alone ignored
probes.engine: tone at rpm/60 Hz, ~0.9 amplitude, no harmonics, throttle independent
probes.wheel_slip: band-limited: rear slip ratio ~0.5-1.3 or slip angle ~0.5-0.8 -> 54.5 Hz tone; larger values, front/all-wheel spin ignored
probes.rumble_strips: no response in either layout: non-functional
probes.shift_indicator: no response in either layout: non-functional
probes.wheel_lock: 56.4 Hz full-scale tone only when the FRONT wheels lock while the rears keep turning, under brake
probes.layout: this plugin decodes gear/pedals at the Forza HORIZON offsets; the 324-byte layout must be used
probes.gear_shift: 94 ms full-scale burst on every gear-byte change (Horizon layout); pure rpm drops ignored
probes.suspension: 41.2 Hz square wave, continuous; amplitude follows recent suspension velocity (1 s peak-hold): ~0.03 smooth, 0.08 at 15/s, 0.2 at 25+/s (strength 0.5)
probes.waveforms: engine, lock, acceleration: sine; suspension: square (h3 .33 h5 .2); gear shift: square-ish burst; slip: sine + small h3
probes.engine_lap: engine amplitude constant 0.159 on the lap regardless of throttle/speed/rpm/gear (strength 0.5)

analysis.strength_law: HaptiConnect effect strength 0.5 produced ~0.22 of the strength-1.0 amplitude (about -13 dB) on the real lap
analysis.fh5_plugin: 60 Hz tone 0.15-0.38 under braking/accel/cornering (FM plugin ~0.1); engine 0.175; 41 Hz bed 0.06-0.14
analysis.rumble_strips: measured on real laps: HaptiConnect DOES render rumble strips (SurfaceRumble 1.5-2.6 + wheel flag): looped rough cycle at ~1.25 Hz per m/s capped ~42 Hz, rms ~0.3 falling to ~0.15 at high speed (strength 0.5); the earlier probe used SurfaceRumble <= 1.0 and never triggered it
analysis.suspension: 41.0 Hz square wave at all speeds; amplitude = max(curve(1 s peak susp velocity), low-speed floor(speed)); pooled from 5 Forza Motorsport laps (strength 0.5)
analysis.shift_indicator: on real laps: continuous ~66-70 Hz tone at full throttle, level ramps with rpm/max from ~0.78 (0.1) to 0.9+ (0.4) at strength 0.5; the synthetic probe never triggered it
analysis.gear_shift_lap: on laps HaptiConnect fires its ~94 ms burst on every gear-byte change (Forza passes through neutral -> two bursts ~220 ms), peak ~0.5-0.7 at strength 0.5, pitch randomized per trigger (p10 24, p50 51, p90 70 Hz)
analysis.fh5_plugin_lap: shift indicator present (on 75-95% at rpm/max >= 0.8); acceleration tone ~0.13 median when on (0.15 braking, 0.38 hard accel, 0.13-0.21 hard cornering); shift bursts 0.86 peak, pitch 26-70 Hz
